name: Obby But You Can't Jump
desc:
Welcome to a different obby, it is like a normal Parkour game but you have a limitation, You Can't Jump, I think it is good to give value to small things lol.

Fun fact: When you finish the game you unlock the jump ability, and can flex on others that didint finish and can't jump yet lol :)

Premium Benefits: Speed Coil

I would like to ask you to please leave a like and a favorite on the game, it helps us a lot, pls support us :D
